creator: Alexander Terp
description:
From #153, batch 13, item 10.

```rad
command api:
    query q str[]
    calls do_api
command user:
    query str
    calls do_user

fn do_api():
    print(query)
fn do_user():
    takes_str(query)   // error[RAD30001]: 'str[]' is not assignable to 'str'
fn takes_str(s: str):
    print(s)
```

On main `rad repro.rad user hello` fails with that error, so a correct script cannot run. Declaring both is accepted; the clash shows only where a callback uses the arg in a typed position, and `rad docs` does not say command args share a namespace.

Scope each command's args to its own callback; failing that, reject the duplicate at its declaration and document the shared namespace.

Where: `rts/check/binder.go:245-257` declares one symbol per name across all commands and keeps the first command's type.
title: Same-named args in two commands share one checker type, and the clash blocks the script
